scope: One current private Version 14 password-reset submission for a newly generated alias of the controlled mailbox. The alias was used transiently, never recorded in this evidence, and was cleared from the page and test state after the replay. No password, account selection, browser cookie, browser storage, real-user record, mail body, or message identifier was read or retained.

worker_log_observation.interpretation: The narrow Worker log window did not provide a request-level receipt. Log retention, sampling, or delay prevents using that absence to prove backend non-receipt.

interpretation.proven: The rendered private password-reset form returned the same generic next-steps response for one fresh controlled alias. The exact controlled mailbox had zero matching messages before submission, immediately after, and after a bounded delayed readback.
not_proven: That no mail could arrive after the bounded delayed readback
A provider outage or provider-specific failure mode
A successful authenticated ordinary-browser mutation or history readback
interpretation.decision: Treat this as narrow non-enumeration and bounded-mailbox evidence only. Do not infer an existing-account provider failure, alter account-disclosure behavior, or weaken reset protections from this replay.
